## Problem and expected behavior

Describe the triggering input, actual failure, expected behavior, and affected
caller or demo workflow.

## Reproduction

Provide a minimal command or example using repository data. Include the actual
and expected results with sanitized output.

## Runtime context

Record relevant OS, Rust/Python versions, installation method, and device.
Never include environment-variable values or credentials.

## Acceptance criteria

Replace these prompts with the concrete correction and its verification:

- [ ] The reproduction produces the expected result after the fix.
- [ ] A relevant regression check demonstrates the corrected behavior.

## Evidence and limitations

Record frequency, affected inputs, comparisons, and anything not yet reproduced.
Distinguish confirmed observations from suspected causes.
